title: From Transformer to Vision Transformer (ViT)
reading: The slide bridges from the Transformer architecture to the Vision Transformer, framing ViT as a building block for vision foundation models. Two bullets summarize the core idea: an image is treated as a sequence of image patches, and a standard Transformer is applied over those patches. The ViT paper by Dosovitskiy et al. (ICLR 2021) is cited.

concepts.name: Vision Transformer (ViT)
concepts.why_it_matters: Applies Transformer architecture to images, underpinning vision foundation models.

concepts.name: Image patches as tokens
